card.name: Gene and drug names before a code
card.fires_on: Marks the spot just before a code or number in a technical name, such as ABC before B1, a letter before a mutation number, or the space after Didanosine before a dose. Also fires on a few the words in technical text.

modes.label: Gene and mutation names
modes.description: Part of a gene or mutation name, right before a letter or number code.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank gap after a drug or standard name, just before a number.

modes.label: The in technical prose
modes.description: The word the inside explanations of how a device or process works.

card.writes: Promotes odd code-like tokens such as .sprites and _INITIALIZER, and suppresses neutral and N.
card.plain: It fires inside technical names just before a code or number follows.
